subject: Luxembourg fiscal representative & PO split — invoice routing and onboarding steps
messages:
From: Claire Dupont <claire.dupont@euroserve.lu>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T14:14:00+01:00
Subject: Onboarding / VAT handling for Luxembourg order (EuroServe)

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. We are preparing to send our first monthly invoice for the consulting engagement starting in December and want to get procurement and tax right on the first pass. A few quick facts about EuroServe:
- Registered name: EuroServe SARL
- LU registration: B12345678
- Billing address: 12 Rue des Artisans, L-1234 Luxembourg
- We are not VAT-registered in Luxembourg today (managed from FR HQ)

Can you confirm:
1) Do you require a Luxembourg fiscal representative for a non-established supplier, or can we register a VAT ID ourselves and bill directly?
2) What do you need on the invoice header (company name, entity to bill, VAT ID, PO number)?
3) Any specific PO routing requirements if we need to split the invoice across two Redwood legal entities?

We can provide a signed fiscal-rep consent if that is easier — looping in Pierre from procurement for PO logistics.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Dupont
Head of Procurement
EuroServe SARL
Attachments: none in this message
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dupont <claire.dupont@euroserve.lu>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T16:03:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding / VAT handling for Luxembourg order (EuroServe)

Hi Claire —

Great to meet today — appreciate the summary. Short answers up front:
- If EuroServe will remain non-established in LU, you either register for LU VAT or appoint a fiscal representative. Either approach is fine; fiscal rep is often quicker for first invoices.
- Invoice header: we need (a) supplier legal name exactly as registered, (b) VAT number (or "fiscal representative VAT" note if not yet assigned), (c) full billing address, (d) Redwood PO number and the requested Redwood legal entity to charge.
- PO split: yes, we can split spend across two Redwood entities. We need a clear allocation per line item (percent or absolute EUR). Please indicate which GL codes to apply when you send the invoice.

Checklist of deliverables from your side to complete onboarding and create POs:
1) Signed fiscal-rep consent (if using a rep) — see attached template EU-Fiscal-Rep-Consent.pdf.
2) Copy of fiscal representative letter (once available) or proof of VAT registration.
3) Completed PO template (Signed-PO-template.pdf attached) with preferred remit/bank details.
4) Contact for invoice and AP escalation (name + email + phone).

Ben in finance will need to confirm VAT handling once we have the fiscal rep letter. Laura, Marcus — FYI on routing and GL mapping.

Next step: Claire, if you can return the signed consent and completed PO template we will push the DocuSign for formal acceptance and create the PO(s).

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachments: EU-Fiscal-Rep-Consent.pdf, Signed-PO-template.pdf

Subject: RE: Luxembourg fiscal representative & PO split — invoice routing and onboarding steps

Team — quick internal next steps after Claire's submission:

1) Ben — please confirm VAT accounting approach once you review EuroServe-FiscalRep-Letter.pdf. My read: assume supplier non-established => fiscal rep indicates LU VAT charged under supplier's VAT (we need to decide reverse-charge vs supplier-charged VAT based on rep's letter).

2) PO creation: Create two POs under Redwood EU SARL (ledger code RU-EU-01) and Redwood Ops Ltd (ledger code RU-OPS-02). Use Claire's allocation on the invoice lines. PO numbers should be referenced verbatim on the invoice.

3) Banking: Invoices should list supplier legal name and their remittance bank (EuroServe SARL IBAN). If fiscal representative is collecting VAT on behalf of EuroServe, we still require EuroServe as supplier on invoice; add a note "VAT handled by fiscal representative" and include rep name.

4) Signatures / legal: I'll send Claire the DocuSign link to confirm fiscal-rep acceptance and attach the signed PO template. DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/examples/abcdef123456

Ben — once you confirm the VAT code (reverse-charge vs VAT-liable), I'll reply to Claire with the final PO numbers and payment cadence.

Thanks,
Laura
Director, Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
